Adding or upgrading a model is ONE clean edit here bound to a level (see model_slot_in). Providers at a level are REPLACEABLE. Invariant policy lives in AGENTS.md/DOCTRINE.md; everything that moves with the market lives here.

review_order_note: GATING fallback order: Opus 5 first (Anthropic gate), then Codex Sol (OpenAI), then Review E (independent-family slot after Sol, only if wired/live/eligible; unwired parks). Fable is OUT of the gating order — rare architecture/long-horizon escalation, same family as Opus, never the post-Sol independent family. Opus 4.8 is a time-bounded Anthropic compatibility fallback, not in this list and not an independent post-Sol family. resolve-route computes the LIVE chain from this order + live_verified registry routes + usage-status tiers. Cross-family = one pass from two DIFFERENT families.

model_slot_in._note: CLEAN SLOT-IN for a new/updated model (Opus 5.1, Fable 5.1, a successor to Fable/Sol, a new implementer). It is ONE edit here — no code or prose changes:
steps: 1. Add a provider entry: id, level (the durable slot it fills), family, kind, model (the new id), functions, capabilities, prowess, billing, detect.
2. To replace an incumbent, set `supersedes: <old-id>` and remove/disable the old entry; keep the SAME level so routing is unchanged.

3. Add or update the matching route in config/model-registry.json. Catalog as catalog_verified/unwired first; promote to live_verified only after official-id, local smoke, role evals, independent evidence, cost/context, and owner approval are typed-attested (attested|not_applicable; new candidates may never use a legacy waiver). official_id needs a direct official https URL. Same-harness receipts are the path to promoting a quality prior into a measured role ranking.
4. If it should join review, add it to review_order at the position its selection priority earns and set review_eligible:true. Quality rank is not selection priority.
5. Run bin/doctor.py (validates level/family/forbidden/order/registry) and bin/smoketest.py. Done — the router and recommendations pick it up.
model_slot_in.supersedes_note: A provider may declare `supersedes` naming the id it replaces; doctor warns if both an entry and its superseded id remain enabled.
